title: AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 end-of-support announced
summary: AWS announced maintenance mode beginning September 8, 2024 and end-of-support on September 8, 2025, and recommended migration to v3.
migration_path: Migrate supported integrations from AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3.
user_impact: Existing v2 applications can continue to run, but the SDK no longer receives updates or releases after end-of-support.
notes: The deadline is an end-of-support boundary, not a runtime-removal claim.
